summary: Iteration 21 verification covering salesman edit RBAC, admin-only duplication, document customer lock, install schedule sales notification state, server-side recipient enforcement, work-status UI scope, and mobile overflow. Backend: 8/8 doc-locking (test_iteration20) + 17/17 install schedule (test_iteration19, -n 0) + 5/5 new iter21 regression suite all PASS. Frontend: salesman Estimate action menu exposes Edit (no 'Create a copy'); clicking the Estimate number opens DocBuilder with [data-testid=save-doc-btn] visible and [data-testid=doc-customer] disabled. Salesman Sales Order action menu exposes Edit; SO number opens DocBuilder with doc-customer disabled, save-doc-btn present, no 'Create a copy'. Mobile 390px: /estimates, /sales-orders, /invoices scrollWidth == innerWidth (no page-level horizontal overflow). Work-status label absent on /estimates, present on /sales-orders and /invoices. Install submit route confirmed in code to notify BCC_COPY_EMAIL (= sales@dbgsigns.com); iter21 pytest injected caller fields (notify_email/recipient/sales_email=attacker@example.com) and asserted no leakage into stored request fields. Live email send kept to one submission per spec; sales_notified_at was present (provider accepted via delivered@resend.dev).
critical_code_review_comments: pytest.ini still ships default -n auto; iter19 install schedule suite requires -n 0 due to shared token registry. Consider adding a per-file worker-override (e.g., pytestmark = pytest.mark.serial with -p no:xdist) or breaking the module-scoped registry into function-scoped fixtures.

server.py update_estimate/update_sales_order/update_invoice duplicate the customer-lock + salesman-preserve logic — extract into a helper (e.g., preserve_salesman_fields_or_401(existing, payload, user)) to prevent drift.

install submit route: notification error path is caught broadly (bare Exception) — logger.warning is fine but include provider status code when available for faster triage of future 429 vs transient errors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all salesman gates and mobile overflow checks passed)

seed_data_creation: iter21 pytest created TEST_iter21_* customers (2 for RBAC, 1 for notify) + 1 estimate / 1 SO / 1 invoice + their admin duplicates + 1 notify-flow SO + its tentative install + install_schedule_requests token; all cleaned up by module teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 21 uses `pytest -n 0` for install schedule and the new iter21 regression file. If invoice UI needs E2E coverage, create an invoice via admin first (both admin and salesman accounts currently have 0 invoices in all tabs on the preview DB). Rate-limit awareness: live Resend sending via BCC_COPY_EMAIL (sales@dbgsigns.com) returns 429 under rapid repeated test runs; the server already captures this as sales_notification_failed_at (non-blocking).
